video_title: “I'm Just Focused On Staying Confident In My Game.” | Jaden McDaniels Postgame Sound | 11.25.26

quotes.speaker: Jaden McDaniels
quotes.summary_phrase: Jaden McDaniels on the Timberwolves' undefeated cup play success
quotes.excerpt: I don't think we've ever been 3-0 in cup play, so just another step closer to the money.
quotes.quote: It feels good. I don't think we've ever been 3-0 in cup play, so just another step closer to the money, and just go ahead and handle business that game.
quotes.social_post: Jaden McDaniels on the Timberwolves being 3-0 in cup play: It feels good. I don't think we have ever been 3-0 in cup play, so just another step closer to the money, and just go ahead and handle business that game.

structured.context: Jaden McDaniels discusses the Timberwolves' 3-0 record in NBA Cup play following a game.

quotes.speaker: Jaden McDaniels
quotes.summary_phrase: Jaden McDaniels on defensive focus and containing Shai Gilgeous-Alexander
quotes.excerpt: Really just defense at the end and then holding them to one shot.
quotes.quote: Really just defense at the end and then holding them to one shot and just taking what they give us. We get out in transition, get easy points, and then just making it hard for Shai Gilgeous-Alexander and really the whole team.
quotes.social_post: Jaden McDaniels on the defensive plan against OKC: Really just defense at the end and then holding them to one shot and just taking what they give us. We get out in transition, get easy points, and then just making it hard for Shai.

structured.context: Jaden McDaniels explains the defensive strategy used to contain Shai Gilgeous-Alexander and the Thunder.

quotes.speaker: Jaden McDaniels
quotes.summary_phrase: Jaden McDaniels on his comfort level with late-game playmaking
quotes.excerpt: They trust me to make the right decision and I trust myself as well.
quotes.quote: I look forward to it. That's something I like. They trust me to make the right decision and I trust myself as well, as whether to shoot, pass it out, throw a lob to Rudy Gobert, and I did it like all three in those possessions. So just continuing to be confident in what I do.
quotes.social_post: Jaden McDaniels on his late game playmaking: They trust me to make the right decision and I trust myself as well, as whether to shoot, pass it out, throw a lob to Rudy Gobert, and I did it like all three in those possessions.

structured.context: Jaden McDaniels reflects on his comfort level and decision-making during late-game possessions involving Rudy Gobert.

quotes.speaker: Jaden McDaniels
quotes.summary_phrase: Jaden McDaniels on his defensive strategy against Shai Gilgeous-Alexander
quotes.excerpt: When he didn't have the ball, just deny him so he doesn't get it back.
quotes.quote: Really just trying to pressure him. I'll say what worked for me is just when he didn't have the ball, just deny him so he doesn't get it back. And then really, he's a good player. He's got two MVPs, so he can do everything on the court, shoot threes, do everything. So it's just a props to him and his work.
quotes.social_post: Jaden McDaniels on defending Shai Gilgeous-Alexander: What worked for me is just when he did not have the ball, just deny him so he does not get it back. He is a good player, he has two MVPs, so he can do everything on the court.

structured.context: Jaden McDaniels details his specific defensive approach to denying the ball to Shai Gilgeous-Alexander.

quotes.speaker: Jaden McDaniels
quotes.summary_phrase: Jaden McDaniels on his offensive development and increased opportunities
quotes.excerpt: The coaches are trusting me, just seeing the work I put in over the years.
quotes.quote: A little bit of both, but mostly just more opportunity. I'll say my team, the coaches are trusting me, just seeing the work I put in over the years to build that trust, and now I just get to play free.
quotes.social_post: Jaden McDaniels on his offensive growth: Mostly just more opportunity. My team, the coaches are trusting me, just seeing the work I put in over the years to build that trust, and now I just get to play free.

structured.context: Jaden McDaniels discusses his offensive growth and the increased trust he has earned from the coaching staff.

quotes.speaker: Jaden McDaniels
quotes.summary_phrase: Jaden McDaniels on maintaining composure in high-stakes games
quotes.excerpt: I'd be excited, but I'd be calm at the same time.
quotes.quote: I'd be calm. I mean, I'd be excited, but I'd be calm at the same time, and just knowing these are the games we want to play. To be a good team, we've got to win games like this, going back and forth up 10, down 10, and just continue to stay with it.
quotes.social_post: Jaden McDaniels on staying composed: I would be calm. I mean, I would be excited, but I would be calm at the same time, and just knowing these are the games we want to play. To be a good team, we have got to win games like this.

structured.context: Jaden McDaniels describes his mindset and composure during high-stakes, back-and-forth games.

quotes.speaker: Jaden McDaniels
quotes.summary_phrase: Jaden McDaniels on the team's collective defensive effort
quotes.quote: Because everybody's giving effort, I'll say that. Everybody's playing. It doesn't matter if I take the best player, they're still giving the same effort, and I feel like we're following the coaching plan that they give us and we're just executing it well.
quotes.social_post: Jaden McDaniels on the team defensive effort: Because everybody is giving effort. It does not matter if I take the best player, they are still giving the same effort, and I feel like we are following the coaching plan.

structured.context: Jaden McDaniels credits the team's collective defensive effort and execution of the coaching staff's game plan.
